title: Expedition Complete
text: Hearthsmoke Vale is mapped, and the Vell know our drones by sight. Whatever we leave standing here, their runners will keep an eye on.

choices.label: Return to Touchdown
choices.reply: The convoy turns for home. A Vell runner keeps pace with it as far as the ridge.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: The expedition stays. The Command Core can take us home whenever we're ready.
